$description: AXIOM design tokens v1.0. Primitives hold raw values, Semantic tokens are roles with Light and Dark values, Component tokens tune parts of components. Use Semantic and Component tokens in products; Primitives only through them.

raised.$description: Cards, fields, dialogs: anything that sits on the canvas.

floating.$description: Dropdowns, menus, popovers: layers above raised surfaces.

sunken.$description: Recessed areas inside a raised surface: filled fields, selected rows, quiet blocks.

hover.$description: Hover of list items, menu rows and ghost buttons.

inverse.$description: Dark surface on light UI: tooltips, toasts.

track.$description: Unfilled part of a measure: empty rating shapes, progress and slider tracks.

selected.$description: Selected row or item, and the bar with actions for the selection: a light wash of the action colour.

shimmer.$description: Moving highlight of skeleton placeholders: lighter than surface/disabled in both themes.

code.$description: Code blocks: always dark in both themes, a step lighter in Dark so it stands off raised cards.

on-action.$description: Text and icons on action/primary: dark ink, 7.1:1 on the brand blue.

negative.$description: Error message under a field. Darker than the orange outline so it passes 4.5:1 on raised and canvas.

link.$description: Links and text buttons. Darker than action/primary so it passes 4.5:1 on raised and canvas.

disabled.$description: Text and icons of disabled controls.

positive.$description: Money in, gains and other good numbers in text. status/positive is for dots and icons.

code.$description: Code text on surface/code. Same in both themes.

code-muted.$description: Language label, Copy action and comments on surface/code.

strong.$description: Outline of a hovered field or a selected card.

focus.$description: Outline of a focused field or control.

negative.$description: Outline of a field with an error.

primary.$description: Main action: primary button, selected control, progress, slider.

disabled.$description: Fill of any disabled action; its text uses text/disabled.

danger.$description: Fill of a destructive action: delete, remove, revoke.

negative.$description: Errors and destructive actions. Orange, not red.

soft.$description: Blue block: info alert, tag, chat bubble, avatar.
Green block: success alert, tag, avatar.
Orange block: warning alert, chat bubble, tag.
Violet block: tag, avatar, premium marks.

solid.$description: Clay: warm neutral accent, chart series.

inner.$description: Elements nested in a field or row. Rule: inner = outer − inset, never larger than the parent.

inline.$description: Between neighbours in a row: icon and label, label and field.

stack.$description: Between fields and groups inside a card.

inset.$description: Inner padding of cards and dialogs.

field.$description: Field and control outline at rest.

focus.$description: Outline of a focused field or control: thicker so focus does not rely on colour alone.

emphasis.$description: Rare strong outline: drop zones, active step.

tooltip.$description: Tooltips and small hints: appear almost at once.

standard.$description: Default curve for anything that moves or resizes on screen.

nudge.$description: Small shift on hover or press.

enter.$description: Dropdowns and toasts slide in by this much.

sheet.$description: Dialogs and sheets rise by this much.
